answer: Each epoch a node’s identity must dock at a verification jetty where it solves a fresh, context‑specific reasoning puzzle generated from the wander of the network’s global plume of embeddings. The solution is signed and broadcast; any replica that cannot reproduce the exact answer is discarded, forcing every Sybil to expend a full model inference cycle per challenge. Because compute scales linearly with the number of forged IDs, an attacker quickly pays prohibitive cloud‑compute costs.
